todo.title: Codify Cardiac Hyper-Focus Mechanic
todo.details: Detail the mechanical execution of Cardiac Hyper-Focus: spending 1 Blood Reserve grants +1 to all perception/tracking checks for 1 scene, but imposes a -1 social penalty due to predator eye glint.

todo.title: Establish Fledgling Creation & Sire-Bond Mechanics
todo.details: Codify the 3-step turning process (Drain, Infuse Vitae, Sanguine Awakening), Sire-Fledgling telepathic compass, and 100-year Centenary Compulsion rules.

todo.title: Detail Sunlight Disintegration & Decapitation Torpor Rules
todo.details: Expand the 3-round Solar Track (Dermal Vaporization, Flesh Ignition, Ash Collapse), Native Soil dependency, and Decapitation Brain Torpor rules.

todo.title: Codify Age Tiers & Blood Reserve Caps
todo.details: Define Blood Capacity scaling across Neonates (<500 yrs = 10 max), Elders (500-1,199 yrs = 13-16 max), and Ancients (1,200+ yrs = 17-22+ max).

todo.title: Define Brink of Death Stages & Torpor Eras
todo.details: Codify Stage 1 (Color Fade), Stage 2 (Sunken Skin), Stage 3 (Lack of Breath), and Stage 4 (Lack of Heartbeat).

todo.title: Expand Power Categories & Innate Framework
todo.details: Categorize Innate (0-cost passive/toggle), Activated (1 reserve), Sustained (1 reserve + 1/round), and Master Composite powers.

todo.title: Establish Coven Laws & Sanctuary Traditions
todo.details: Codify The Shroud, Haven Sanctuary, Sanguine Tithe, and Tabula Rasa Coven Laws.

todo.title: Detail Blood Archive Phials & Thrall Blood Bonds
todo.details: Define Blood Archive psychic memory phials, Thrall blood bonding (1 draft per 14 days), and Thrall aging suspension.

todo.title: Codify Mutant Types, Feral Husks & Spliced Reapers
todo.details: Define Feral Husks, Hollow Abominations, and Spliced Reaper epidemic creation rules.

todo.title: Deepen Historical Lore & Cultural Divide Between Eras
todo.details: Enrich New World vs Old World lore detailing historical shifts, societal expectations, age milestone ceremonies, and the ideological divide between ancient traditionalists and modern neonates.

todo.title: Establish Ancient Vitae, Permanent Power Gain & Soul Strain Mechanics
todo.details: Add Tier 5 Ancient Vitae (1,200+ years) granting 4 Blood Reserves, 1 Permanent Power Slot per draft (once per century), Soul Strain Risk (Hard Self-Control check), and Full Diablerie rules (Eternal Petrified Torpor).

todo.title: Implement Creation Limitations & Anti-Mass Siring Rules
todo.details: Add 5 Blood Reserves siring cost, 30-Day Bloodline Cooldown (Sanguine Exhaustion), 3-Year Psychic Rebound (emotional static bleed & Psychic Overload Hazard), and Progeny Capacity Caps based on age tier.

todo.title: Formalize 3-Tier Age Hierarchy (Neonates, Elders, Ancients)
todo.details: Structure vampire types into 3 formal age categories: Neonates (<500 yrs), Elders (500-1,199 yrs), and Ancients (1,200+ yrs), defining starting NPC pools, species perks, and societal roles for each.

todo.title: Integrate Round 13 Audit Fixes (Torpor Stasis, Omni-Sensory Flashbang Immunity, Trailing Minions, Natural Critical Guarantee)
todo.details: Codified Native Soil Torpor Stasis, Stage 4 petrification vs ash distinction, Nyctophilous Apex Sight in Omni-Sensory Primacy, Trailing Minion Boundary Rules, and Natural Critical Success Guarantee.

todo.title: Integrate Round 14 & Archiver Audit Fixes (Bloodline Duel, Reaper Contagion Thrall +2 Bonus, Archiver Immunity)
todo.details: Codified Dual-Master Bloodline Duel system, Thrall Reaper contagion +2 resistance bonus, Blood Archive 1-action + combat overload penalty, Archiver immunity, Primary Reaper lifespan, and Tabula Rasa discipline tiers.

todo.title: Integrate Round 15 & 16 Audit Fixes (Structural Intactness Creation, Wooden Stake Torpor Paralysis, Sci-Fi Soil Containment, Millennial Scaling)
todo.details: Codified Structural Intactness requirement for Creation, Wooden Stake Catatonic Torpor Paralysis vs True Death, Anchor Empathy Shielding, Post-Feeding animal panic reduction, Daywalker UV immunity, Sci-Fi soil containment, Re-Rooting interruption tiers, and Millennial Scaling override.

todo.title: Audit Phantasm Mental Illusion vs Cybernetic Optic Implants & Digital HUDs
todo.details: Codified Cybernetic Optic Interaction: Phantasm affects organic mind, but raw digital HUD overlays display un-distorted feeds, inflicting a -2 perceptual disorientation penalty.

todo.title: Audit Corpse Siphon Interrogation Scope on Living / Torpid Decapitated Heads
todo.details: Codified Undead Head Interrogation Scope: Corpse Siphon targets ONLY deceased mortal/host corpses; living or torpid decapitated vampire heads are immune and require Mind Tear.

todo.title: Audit Law of the Sanguine Tithe Hardship Deferral & Forced Draining Rules
todo.details: Codified Tithe Hardship Exemption: 0-harvest weeks due to injury/stasis grant a 1-week deferral; 2 unpaid weeks allow Apex Elder forced vein draining (2 reserves) or punitive labor.

todo.title: Audit Daywalker's Grace Solar Timer Drain During Swarm Pocket-Realm Shift
todo.details: Codified Solar Swarm Transference Timer: sunlight on manifested swarm transfers solar burn into Pocket-Realm body, continuously burning the 3-minute timer until forced Stage 4 Torpor.

todo.title: Audit Sub-Auditory Tremor Echo Airborne & Levitating Target Blind Spot
todo.details: Codified Airborne & Levitating Blind Spot: Sub-Auditory Tremor Echo senses surface vibrations only; flying/levitating targets do not touch surfaces and are completely invisible to Tremor Echo.

todo.title: Audit Nerve Lightning Bio-Electrical Target Scope vs Kinetic Barrier Deflection
todo.details: Codified Bio-Neural Scope & Force Barriers: Kinetic Barrier deflects solid projectiles, but non-physical bio-electrical attacks (Nerve Lightning) pass through force barriers, requiring Psychic Fortress or total cover.

todo.title: Audit Chameleon Facade Thermal FLIR Signature Lock
todo.details: Codified Thermal Signature Lock: Chameleon Facade alters physical facial features and voice, but does not generate internal body heat, displaying as a cold blue/violet silhouette under FLIR optics.

todo.title: Audit Soul Bind Incorporeal Daylight Anchor Protection
todo.details: Codified Incorporeal Daylight Anchor Protection: bound spirits retreat inside their physical anchor object during daylight hours; destroying the physical anchor object permanently banishes the bound spirit.

todo.title: Audit Blood Surge Single-Stat Duration Overwrite Cap
todo.details: Codified Single-Stat Overwrite Cap: executing a new Blood Surge on a subsequent combat round immediately overwrites previous surge stat bonuses, maintaining a single +2 stat bonus (+2 Strength OR +2 Speed OR +2 Initiative) at any given moment under per-round expenditure caps.

todo.title: Audit Visage of the Abyssal Nightmare Fear Stun Immunity Cooldown
todo.details: Codified Fear Stun Immunity & Age Tier Superiority: Visage checks are modified by Age Tier Superiority (+1 vs Neonates, +2 vs Elders); a target successfully affected gains an immediate 1-Scene immunity window against subsequent Visage fear stuns.

todo.section: ## Powers -> Combined Power Usage & Synergistic Scaling
todo.title: Codify Combined Power Usage, Synergistic Bonuses, and Age Tier Synergy Scaling Matrix
todo.details: Codified Coven Power Ritual Nexus (Multi-Caster Stacking, Age Tier Caster Caps up to 7, Sequential Round-Robin Rotation Upkeep of 1 Reserve/Round Total, and Disruption Counterplay) alongside Synergistic Pair Bonus (+1) and Age Tier Synergy Multipliers.

todo.title: Audit Puppet Master Motor Control vs Vocal Cord Compliance
todo.details: Codified Anatomical Motor Scope & Vocal Prohibition: Puppet Master controls external push-pull and stabilizer muscles only; it cannot manipulate internal organs, diaphragmatic respiration, or vocal cords, preventing forced speech or password recitation.

todo.title: Audit Centenary Compulsion Contradictory Sire Command Supremacy
todo.details: Codified Contradictory Command Supremacy: contradictory Sire commands do not cause paralysis loops; the Sire's most recent explicit command immediately supersedes all previous conflicting directives.

todo.title: Audit Apex Vault Blood Theft Penalty under Coven Governance
todo.details: Codified 5th Sacred Coven Law (The Law of Sanguine Justice), system-agnostic Blood Tithing Protocols (Sealed Tithe Vessels & Closed-Conduit Donations across Fantasy/Modern/Sci-Fi), Apex Vault High Theft penalties (30-Day Power Lockout & 1-Year Double Tithe), and Judicial Exemptions to Haven Sanctuary.

todo.title: Audit Echolocation Pulse Active Sonar Cancellation in Silence Dead Zones
todo.details: Codified Silence Suppression & Faded Mental Map Memory: entering a silence dead zone or vacuum suppresses active sonar pings, but pre-scanned terrain remains in memory as a faded, generalized mental layout map, losing real-time movement tracking.

todo.title: Audit Abyssal Levitation Airborne Melee Recoil & Grapple Stability
todo.details: Codified Kinetic Air Recoil & Stability: levitation maintains air stability for standard melee strikes, but physical grapples or heavy anti-materiel firearms suffer a -1 Recoil Instability penalty unless anchored or supported by Mind Grip.

todo.title: Audit Bloodline Memory Distant Sire Historical Scope Lock
todo.details: Codified Historical Scope Lock: Bloodline Memory accesses past historical memories only, preventing real-time camera/spy feed usage into a living Sire's present activities.

todo.title: Audit Siren's Cadence Audio Recording Playback Immunity
todo.details: Codified Live Vocal Presence Requirement: Siren's Cadence relies on live vocal presence and aura; recorded audio played through speakers loses all supernatural compel properties.

todo.title: Audit Corpse Siphon Decapitated Host Head-Touch Requirement
todo.details: Codified Head-Touch Neural Requirement: Corpse Siphon extracts neural residual memories from the brain cortex; the vampire must make direct skin contact with the decapitated head itself.

todo.title: Audit Electromagnetic Shroud Gaze Passive Optical Fiber Blindspot
todo.details: Codified Passive Optical Blindspot: unpowered glass fiber-optic tubes emit zero EM radiation, remaining hidden from EM Shroud Gaze unless inspected via thermal or apex sight.

todo.title: Audit Grave Rot Synthetic Cybernetic & Polymer Degradation Scope
todo.details: Codified Synthetic & Cybernetic Scope: Grave Rot degrades structural integrity across all tech eras (iron, steel, Kevlar, synthetic polymers, cybernetic joints), excepting sacred relics, blood archives, and artifacts.

todo.title: Audit Blood Harmonic Direct Visual Line-of-Sight CCTV Limit
todo.details: Codified Direct Visual Line-of-Sight Requirement: Blood Harmonic requires direct unmediated visual gaze in physical space; digital screens, mirrors, and CCTV camera feeds filter out the gaze harmonic.

todo.title: Audit Sanguine Spike Underwater Solidification Integrity
todo.details: Codified Environmental Density Solidification: Sanguine Spikes solidify instantly via supernatural pressure magic and do not dissolve in water, mud, or liquid atmospheres.

todo.title: Audit The Collective Whisper Supernatural Entity Exclusion
todo.details: Codified Supernatural Entity Exclusion: Collective Whisper affects unconditioned mortal minds only; vampires or supernaturals in the crowd are immune and alerted to the caster's location.

todo.title: Audit Veil Flicker Line-of-Sight Destination & Solid Obstacle Bounce-Back
todo.details: Codified Visual Destination Scope & Spatial Bounce-Back: Veil Flicker requires visual line-of-sight or active sensor mapping; attempting blind teleports into unmapped solid terrain causes spatial bounce-back and 1 Direct Damage.

todo.title: Audit Grave Chill Cryo-Brittleness Kinetic Impact Vulnerability
todo.details: Codified Kinetic Impact & Structural Fragility: bludgeoning strikes or Kinetic Blast against frozen targets deal +1 bonus impact damage, and parrying with frozen weapons carries a 1-in-6 shatter chance.

todo.title: Audit Soul Bind Incorporeal Sentry Interdimensional Detection Limit
todo.details: Codified Ethereal Vitae Detection: bound spirits sense ethereal vitae signatures rather than light reflections, detecting manifested swarms and Pocket-Realm tethers.

todo.title: Audit Cognitive Distortion Target Orientation & Blind Fire Penalty
todo.details: Codified Disorientation Penalty Scope: Cognitive Distortion imposes a -2 penalty to all physical attack rolls (melee and ranged) and forces area-of-effect attacks to scatter.

todo.title: Audit Phantasm Non-Biological AI & Drone Immunity
todo.details: Codified Non-Biological AI Immunity: automated AI turrets, combat drones, and non-biological sensors lack organic brain tissue and are completely immune to Phantasm.

todo.title: Audit Aura of the Slumbering Legion Underwater & Soil Submersion Minion Mobility
todo.details: Codified Physical Excavation Constraints: re-animated corpses retain mortal physical Strength caps; buried corpses take 1 round to claw through loose soil and cannot breach solid concrete without excavation.

todo.title: Audit Pyre Aura Underwater & Extinguishing Exemption
todo.details: Codified Pressurized Vitae Fuel & Extinguishing Exemption: Pyre Aura consumes pressurized blood as fuel, burning continuously underwater, in heavy rain, in vacuums, or under fire suppression foam without extinguishing.

todo.title: Audit Mind Grip Reaction Speed & Supersonic Projectile Limit
todo.details: Codified Off-Turn Reaction Interception & Supersonic Velocity Bounds: Mind Grip can catch thrown weapons, arrows, and subsonic pistol rounds off-turn, but supersonic rifle/sniper rounds exceed neural reaction speeds and require pre-manifested Kinetic Barrier.

todo.title: Audit Chameleon Facade Thermal FLIR Signature Masking Failure
todo.details: Codified Thermal FLIR Masking Failure: Chameleon Facade alters dermal contours and voice pitch but does NOT generate body heat, remaining visible as a cold blue silhouette under FLIR thermal imaging sensors.

todo.title: Audit Grand Harmonization of Vitae Severed Limb Regrowth Time
todo.details: Codified Severed Limb Regrowth Duration & Concentration Math: Re-attaching a retrieved limb costs 1 Reserve in 1 round; re-growing a missing limb from scratch requires 3 Reserves total over 3 consecutive combat rounds under concentration.

todo.title: Audit Daywalker's Grace Concentrated Solar Beam Multiplier
todo.details: Codified Concentrated Solar Beam Acceleration Multiplier (3x Drain): Ambient natural sunlight drains Daywalker's 180s timer at 1:1 speed, but focused high-intensity solar weaponry (solar lenses, orbital mirrors) overloads sigils, consuming the timer at 3x speed.

todo.title: Audit Supernatural Kinetic Crash Impact & Wall Collision Recoil Math
todo.details: Codified Kinetic Crash Impact & Recoil Math: Sprinting into unyielding barriers at supernatural speed deals 1 Blunt Damage to the obstacle; if unbreached, unyielding barriers reflect kinetic rebound inflicting 1 Blunt Recoil Damage on the vampire unless shielded by Kinetic Barrier.

todo.title: Audit Kinetic Crush Mechanical Joint Lock vs Internal Tissue Scope
todo.details: Codified Cybernetics & Powered Armor Servomotor Joint Lock Scope: Kinetic Crush crushes external joint servomotors (locking mechanical joints and disabling powered bonuses) while passing through physical armor plates to inflict crushing damage on internal biological bones unless shielded by Kinetic Barrier.

todo.title: Audit Mind Tear Foundational Bloodline Memory Wiping Prohibition
todo.details: Codified Foundational Bloodline & Heritage Memory Wiping Prohibition: Mind Tear and Lethe's Touch can probe/wipe mundane memories or passcodes, but CANNOT erase or sever Sire-Fledgling telepathic compasses, Centenary Compulsions, Anchors, or bloodline heritage.

todo.title: Audit Weaver's Eclipse Swarm Mass Dispersal & Partial Destruction Math
todo.details: Codified Swarm Mass Dispersal, Partial Destruction & Automatic Pocket-Realm Ejection Math: Destroying swarm mass via AoE fire/explosions inflicts 1 Wound per 25% swarm mass destroyed; reaching >= 75% swarm destruction triggers automatic pocket-realm spatial ejection, re-forming a mangled torso in Stage 3 Torpor.

todo.title: Audit Thrall Blood Bond Diablerie Inheritance vs True Death Withdrawal
todo.details: Codified Master True Death Withdrawal, Diablerie Bond Inheritance & Thrall Cap Overage Strain: True Death triggers acute Thrall withdrawal; Diablerie inherits blood bonds. Overage Thralls impose -1 daily Reserve regen & -1 Self-Control penalties until resolved via Sanctioned Termination off Coven grounds or Coven Council Dispensation.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Blood Reserve Cost & Sacrificial Upkeep
todo.title: Clarify Sacrificial Substitution — Valid Blood Source Definitions
todo.details: Sacrificial Substitution (250ml living blood = 1 Reserve) does not define valid blood sources. Clarify whether Synth-Vitae phials, corpse blood, vampire vitae, or animal blood qualify as substitution sources. Each source type should have explicit eligibility and potency rules.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 3 Primordial Rites -> Grand Rite of Hematic Transmutation
todo.title: Exploit: Grand Rite Blood Reserve Regeneration Cap — 1,000 Gallon Unlimited Exploit
todo.details: Grand Rite of Hematic Transmutation allows rival vampires to regenerate 1 Blood Reserve per gallon of transmuted water consumed. With 1,000 gallons available, any vampire can restore up to 1,000 Blood Reserves — bypassing all expenditure cap rules. Codify a per-session ingestion cap (e.g., maximum reserves regained capped by the vampire's standard Reserve pool size per feeding session).

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 3 Primordial Rites -> Grand Rite of Hematic Transmutation
todo.title: Exploit: Grand Rite Thrall Cap Overage — Instant Mass Enthrallment Edge-Case
todo.details: Grand Rite transmuted water makes any mortal drinking it 'instantly susceptible to Thrall Enthrallment.' This could trigger mass involuntary Thrall bonds if the caster is near Thrall Cap, causing Thrall Cap Overage Strain (see TODO-56). Clarify whether drinking transmuted water creates an automatic bond or merely grants susceptibility — and explicitly cross-reference Thrall Cap Overage Strain penalties.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Coven Circle Chants & Age Tier Synergy
todo.title: Exploit: Coven Circle Fortitude Bonus Stack — No Cap Creates Trivial Auto-Pass
todo.details: Coven Circle Chants grant +1 Ritual Fortitude per secondary participant with no stated cap. A 10-member coven grants +10 to every Ritual Fortitude check (DC 15), making concentration checks trivially auto-passable. Codify a cap on Fortitude bonus stacking (e.g., max +5 bonus regardless of circle size), while retaining the 50% casting time cap.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 1 Blood Rituals -> Ritual of the Crimson Ward
todo.title: Edge-Case: Crimson Ward 'Invited' Definition Undefined — Invitation & Revocation Rules Missing
todo.details: The Crimson Ward triggers for 'uninvited' mortals or vampires but does not define what constitutes an invitation, who can issue one, whether invitations can be revoked, or whether the caster themselves is always considered invited. Codify invitation authority (caster only vs any Coven member), revocation mechanics, and edge-case for Coven exile rendering the caster uninvited in their own warded haven.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 3 Primordial Rites -> Eclipse of the Sanguine Tide
todo.title: Exploit: Eclipse of the Sanguine Tide — Daywalker's Grace Infinite Stacking via Repeated Casts
todo.details: Eclipse extends Daywalker's Grace timers by +1 minute for all allied vampires. With multiple successive Ancient casters, repeated Eclipse castings could stack indefinitely, creating effectively infinite Daywalker's Grace coverage. Codify a maximum cumulative extension cap per night (e.g., Daywalker's Grace timer cannot exceed its base 3-minute cap + 2 minutes maximum bonus regardless of Eclipse stacking).

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Ritual Interruption & Backfire Trauma
todo.title: Gap: Concentration Check DC Not Scaled by Age Tier
todo.details: Ritual Interruption Concentration Test is hardcoded at DC 15 for all vampires. An Ancient with centuries of ritual practice should maintain concentration more effectively than a Neonate. Codify Age Tier Concentration Resilience: Neonate = DC 15 (Hard), Elder = DC 12 (Medium), Ancient = DC 9 (Easy).

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 1 Blood Rituals -> Sanguine Scrying Mirror
todo.title: Gap: Scrying Mirror 5-Mile Radius Reference Point Ambiguous
todo.details: Sanguine Scrying Mirror states the target must be 'within a 5-mile radius' but does not specify whether this radius is measured from the caster's position or the scrying focus object location. Also undefined: whether the caster can take actions during the 10-minute scrying feed or is physically immobilized during the vision. Clarify both ambiguities.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 1 Blood Rituals -> Vitae Purification Filter
todo.title: Gap: Vitae Purification Filter — Multi-Contaminant Scope & Reaper Virus Reference
todo.details: Vitae Purification Filter does not specify whether one casting neutralizes all simultaneous contaminants (silver + Reaper virus in the same blood) or only one per Reserve cost. Additionally, 'Reaper virus' is referenced without any prior definition in the core ruleset or supplement — add a lore footnote or cross-reference. Also clarify whether the power operates on blood already inside the caster's system or only on blood being ingested.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 2 Blood Sorcery -> Rhythm of the Ancestral Lineage
todo.title: Gap: Ancestral Lineage Communion — Living Sire Conflict & Skill System Alignment
todo.details: Rhythm of the Ancestral Lineage does not clarify whether the ritual contacts a living Sire (creating a two-way telepathic security risk) or only deceased ancestral echoes. Additionally, skill categories 'Lore, Strategy, and Arcane Perception checks' are not formally defined in vampire.md — align to the core ruleset's official skill system taxonomy.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 2 Blood Sorcery -> Sanguine Transfusion Lock
todo.title: Contradiction: Sanguine Transfusion Lock Duration Label Inconsistency
todo.details: Sanguine Transfusion Lock is labeled 'Duration: Instantaneous (Action Lock)' but the effect persists for '1 combat round,' which is not instantaneous. The label is internally contradictory. Clarify the cost label to 'Duration: 1 Combat Round' and define exactly what 'locks physical limbs' means: can the target still speak, activate powers, or cast their own rituals while locked?

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 3 Primordial Rites -> Grand Rite of Hematic Transmutation
todo.title: Contradiction: Grand Rite Duration 'Permanent / 24 Hours' Ambiguous
todo.details: Grand Rite of Hematic Transmutation duration is listed as 'Permanent / 24 Hours' with no clarification of which effect is permanent vs temporary. Does the water transmutation last 24 hours before reverting, or is it permanent? Clarify: the transmutation lasts 24 hours before reverting to normal water, and codify what happens to any Thrall susceptibility bonds established during that window after reversion.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Tier 2 Blood Sorcery -> Hematic Curse of Inertia
todo.title: Gap: Hematic Curse Caster Concentration Maintenance Not Specified
todo.details: Hematic Curse of Inertia persists for 1 Scene with a per-turn resistance check for the target — but no rule states whether the caster must maintain active concentration for the curse to persist. Clarify: if the caster is incapacitated, enters Torpor, or dies during the curse's duration, the curse immediately ends. Also define whether the curse can be cast on multiple targets simultaneously or is strictly single-target.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Coven Circle Chants & Age Tier Synergy
todo.title: Gap: Coven Circle — Age Tier Eligibility for Participants Not Defined
todo.details: Coven Circle Chants do not define whether participants must meet a minimum age tier to contribute meaningfully to higher-tier rituals. Codify eligibility: any vampire may participate in Tier 1 circles; Tier 2 circles require at least Elder-tier primary caster; Tier 3 Primordial Rites require an Ancient primary caster, with participants of any tier contributing the standard +1 Fortitude and 10% time reduction.

todo.section: ## Bloodline Magic Compendium -> Foundational Ritual Mechanics
todo.title: Gap: No Rule for Ritual Pause, Resume, or Voluntary Cancellation
todo.details: No rule exists for voluntarily cancelling a ritual mid-cast or pausing and resuming it. Codify: voluntary cancellation before completion forfeits 50% of spent Blood Reserves (half lost, half returned). Rituals cannot be paused and resumed — a cancelled ritual requires a fresh full-duration casting and full Reserve cost to restart.
